newsitem.title: UK: Ldn platinum fixed at $398.75, high since Aug 29.
newsitem.headline: Ldn platinum fixed at $398.75, high since Aug 29.

text.p: Platinum was fixed at $398.75 per ounce on Friday, its highest fixing since August 29, 1996.
Dealers said the rise from the Thursday close of $386.00/$387.00 was driven by buying in Tokyo over concerns about continuing delays in Russia shipping supplies of the rare white metal to Japan.
At its highest during Far East trading spot platinum was indicated at $406.00, a level not seen since May 1996.
Russia is the world's second largest producer of platinum after South Africa and Japan the largest importer of the metal which is used in jewellery, car exhaust clean up systems and electronics.
Negotiations for 1997 supply contracts between the two countries should have started last December but have been delayed through Russian administrative problems and no metal has been shipped.
"What happens next depends on Russia. If they start talking, the price could come off quickly. If not, we could see furher rises," a dealer said.
